Path: access-security.share-link-landing-page

## Triage: `domain:server` · p2 · `pm:queue` · 2026-11-02T08:25Z

⛔ Not a claim.

- Read fresh. The fix lands in createLink in packages/plugins/plugin-sharing/src/share-link-service.ts, which stores redact_fields as given (near line 670) without checking each name against the object's fields, so domain:server. It is p2 as a user-visible behaviour defect: a misspelt redaction is accepted and the landing page claims the field is hidden. It is graded rather than flagged because no access policy is bypassed (the link serves only what its own minter chose to share), so it is a mint-time validation gap, not an authN/authZ gap, cross-tenant read or secret leak; it is a concrete defect with a repro, so pm:queue.
